text:
alex: FYI customer cust-987 reports P99 spikes and a cost jump. Console shows endpoint region eu-west-1 but their request logs show responses served from us-east-1. They saw ~250ms extra RTT and some 502s. Can we validate? :eyes:

mira: any trace id or example request?

alex: trace id abc123-trace. Repro steps I ran from their repro machine:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=gpt-open-eu
```
Response headers excerpt:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: abc123-trace
x-served-region: us-east-1
x-routing-decision: fallback->us-east-1
```
Console UI (screenshot attached by customer) shows region: eu-west-1 in the endpoint details page.

mira: that header is very useful. Does the audit log show a routing override or capacity fallback?

tom: pulling smart-routing logs for trace abc123-trace... one sec.

tom: got it. rctl query-logs --trace abc123-trace | jq '.route_decision' returned:
```
{"route_decision": "primary-unavailable", "fallback_region": "us-east-1", "reason": "capacity_pressure_eu-west", "timestamp": 1851234566}
```
So the runtime fell back to us-east due to capacity pressure.

alex: did we communicate fallbacks in the console? customer says they were not warned and thought traffic stayed in eu-west.

kevin: short answer: console shows the endpoint's configured primary region (eu-west-1) — that view doesn't update to show per-request dynamic fallbacks. We emit metrics and headers for served_region but the endpoint detail page currently doesn't display last-served-region or recent fallback count. That's a gap.

jan: billing question — customer flagged a sudden cross-region egress and extra cost. If requests get served from us-east, standard cross-region pricing applies. Need request logs time window to quantify. alex can you share last 24h request ids for cust-987?

alex: sharing CSV in thread DM.

mira: root cause timeline: at 03:00 UTC there was a scheduled maintenance (eu-west reserved pool) that reduced available slots; autoscaler tried to fill but throttle window caused short capacity_pressure spikes ~03:12-03:20 UTC, triggering fallback_policy:allow_cross_region. Fallbacks were expected but we failed to surface them in the console or as a warning banner.

kevin: mitigation options:
- short-term: set routing header X-Prefer-Region: eu-west-1 to force same-region routing (note: may queue or error if no capacity)
- medium: increase reserved capacity for that customer or advise Dedicated reservation for steady throughput
- platform: add recent fallback_count and last_served_region to endpoint details + a sticky banner for active fallbacks

tom: also saw a handful of 401/403 in the same window for that customer where token scope mismatch caused auth retries which sometimes hit fallback logic. Recommend customer rotate token and ensure token scope includes 'eu-west' (they had a token issued in us-central org).

alex: customer wants a timeline and either a credit or to pin traffic to eu-west. Any advice on credits?

jan: I'll calculate impact once I get the CSV. We can offer a good-faith credit for cross-region egress + a follow-up if we failed to warn.

mira: action items:
- tom: confirm if fallback_count metric triggered alert threshold and why no ops page banner fired. (assigned)
- kevin: short-term doc snippet for support to advise customers on X-Prefer-Region usage and failure modes. (assigned)
- jan: estimate billing delta and propose credit. (assigned)
- alex: share customer CSV and timeline and let me know if they want to pin or increase reservation. (assigned)

region-monitor-bot: ALERT: eu-west fallback_count increased to 42 in 03:10-03:20 UTC window (threshold 20).

kevin: quick note on X-Prefer-Region header example:
```http
X-Prefer-Region: eu-west-1
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
This will prefer same-region routing but can return 429/503 if capacity insufficient. Use only if customer understands tradeoffs.

alex: customer opted to have us pin traffic for the next 2 hours while we dig in. They want the console to show served-region history.

mira: tracking a small internal follow-up to add "recent served regions" to endpoint details (postmortem item).

support-bot: Thanks team — please update the shared incident doc and set a follow-up with cust-987. If fallback reoccurs outside scheduled maintenance open an incident in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
